description: What X Ode and its backend embed at build time to verify the Calimocho engine release index (ADR-0082): trusted Ed25519 public keys, each bound to one epoch; revoked keyids; the minimum (epoch, index_version) floor; and engines revoked at build time. Private keys never enter any repository, Keychain or CI.

keys.note: Production key 2026-10. Private key on the maintainer Mac: ~/.config/calimocho/engine-index/engine-index-ed25519-2026-10.pem (mode 0600, passphrase-encrypted).
